flows:
Navigate to https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/whiteNoiseGenerator.php then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Immediately after opening the page, press Tab once.
The first tab stop is the Menu icon in the top corner.
With the Menu icon focused, press Enter once.
Then verify the open navigation shows Full Index.
Use Tab and Enter to open it.
Verify the site navigation opens and the Full Index link is visible.

summary:
The Menu control did not keep the visitor in the navigation flow when activated with the keyboard. It moved to homepage content, so Full Index could no longer be reached from the expected open menu.
Fix the Menu icon's Enter-key behavior so it opens the navigation panel and leaves the Full Index link available; then retest with keyboard-only navigation.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Keyboard activation navigated to homepage sections; the navigation panel and Full Index link are no longer available.

one_liner: Pressing Enter on the focused Menu icon sent the page to homepage sections instead of opening the site navigation.
